name: learning-probability
description: Probability learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual probability topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-topic engine atom on the physics/math canvas.

schema.name: learning-probability
schema.description: Probability learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual probability topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-topic engine atom on the physics/math canvas.

emits.description: The current scene each tick — a composed listener (histogram, readout, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: Bodies Updated
events.description: The current scene each tick — a composed listener (histogram, readout, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.description: Downward acceleration added to each falling ball's vy every tick (y grows downward).

bodies.label: Bodies
bodies.description: 16 balls dropped from the top center; the widening horizontal spread at the floor forms the bell curve.

jitter.label: Jitter
jitter.description: Half-width of the per-tick random horizontal kick in pixels; the peg deflections that build the spread.

floor.label: Floor
floor.description: Y pixel at which a ball has landed; at or below it the ball freezes and the pile persists.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick integrates; toggle to start/pause the drop.

shapes.label: Shapes
shapes.description: Triangular grid of 15 static peg markers the balls deflect around as they fall.

width.label: Width
width.description: Simulation width in pixels; bounds the horizontal walk.

emits.description: The current walker cloud each tick — a composed listener (histogram, readout, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: Points Updated
events.description: The current walker cloud each tick — a composed listener (histogram, readout, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

step.label: Step
step.description: Half-width of each per-tick random displacement in data units; larger diffuses faster.

points.label: Points
points.description: 24 walkers all seeded at the origin; the widening cloud IS the visual — one red walker tracks a single trajectory.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick random-walks every walker; toggle to start/pause the diffusion.

emits.description: The current point field each tick — a composed listener (π readout, histogram, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: Points Updated
events.description: The current point field each tick — a composed listener (π readout, histogram, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

points.label: Points
points.description: ~250 samples uniform in the [-5,5] square; red points fall inside the inscribed radius-5 circle, blue outside — the red fraction ≈ π/4.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick re-scatters every point uniformly in the [-5,5] square and recolors it; toggle to start/pause.
